Redefine_Guidelines: Product requirements must use specific, measurable metrics for targets and thresholds.
Do not reference 'Equal or better than Predecessor' in requirement statements.
All functional and experience improvements must include measurable metrics.
Requests for Feature, Experience, and Warranty Improvements must be routed to the appropriate Function Owners (Marketing, GxD, TME) for holistic assessment.
Best practices should not be included as requirements.

In_Scope_Product_Specific: Performance/Feature requirements specific to the product.
Quality Improvement & Serviceability unique to the product.
Telemetry requirements specific to the product.
Documentation and Process requirements unique to the product.
Test Setup/Fixture requirements unique to the product.
Design For Manufacturing requirements unique to the product.
Cost Reduction requirements unique to the product.

Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Challenge: It is difficult for Quality and Marketing to write technical specs or values for subjective requirements.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Past_Practice: Use of vague statements like 'equal or better than predecessor'.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Proposal: State what the customer expects instead of vague statements. Targets and thresholds should be clear and actionable.

Example_Case_1_Tire_Mark.Requirement_From_Customer_Perspective: No visible tire mark on photo media.
Example_Case_1_Tire_Mark.Threshold_Acceptable_to_Ship: Minor tire mark acceptable (metric to be defined with program).
